title: MMLongEmbed: Benchmarking Multimodal Embedding Models in Long-Context Scenarios
abstract: arXiv:2606.14747v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Recent advancements have significantly expanded the theoretical context windows of Multimodal Embedding Models (MEMs). However, larger context windows do not necessarily translate into effective comprehension and representation of long-context multimodal inputs, which remains a critical bottleneck for real-world deployment. To address the lack of systematic evaluation in this setting, we introduce MMLongEmbed, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating MEMs in long-context scenarios. MMLongEmbed comprises four retrieval tasks spanning multiple context-length ranges, covering text, document, and video modalities. Through extensive evaluation of state-of-the-art models, we find that current architectures rely heavily on superficial feature matching and struggle to capture deep semantic and structural dependencies. translated_title: MMLongEmbed：面向长上下文场景的多模态嵌入模型基准测试
translated_abstract: 摘要（arXiv:2606.14747v2，公告类型：replace-cross）：近年来的研究进展显著扩展了多模态嵌入模型的理论上下文窗口。然而，更大的上下文窗口并不一定意味着能够有效理解和表示长上下文的多模态输入，这仍然是其实际部署中的关键瓶颈。为解决该场景下缺乏系统性评估的问题，我们提出了 MMLongEmbed，这是首个用于评估多模态嵌入模型在长上下文场景中表现的综合性基准。MMLongEmbed 包含四个检索任务，覆盖多个上下文长度范围，涉及文本、文档和视频三种模态。通过对当前最先进模型的大规模评估，我们发现现有架构严重依赖表面特征匹配，难以捕捉深层的语义和结构依赖关系。我们进一步观察到，模型性能的下降随上下文长度和关键信息位置呈现出系统性的变化规律……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了首个面向长上下文场景的多模态嵌入模型综合评测基准 MMLongEmbed，通过覆盖文本、文档和视频模态的四个检索任务，揭示了现有模型依赖表面特征匹配、难以捕捉深层语义与结构依赖的局限性。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MMLongEmbed, the first comprehensive benchmark for evaluating multimodal embedding models in long-context scenarios across text, document, and video modalities, revealing that current models rely heavily on superficial feature matching and struggle to capture deep semantic and structural dependencies.
